result.summary: The screen is mostly functional and clean, with a couple of minor layout and content issues regarding text clipping and placeholder assets.

issues.description: The third restaurant title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated abruptly as 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or allow wrapping onto a second line.

issues.description: Dishes across cards use simplified flat illustrations rather than authentic food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic vector artwork with high-resolution food photos.
